notes.title: SEASON 2222
notes.notes:
Welcome to DAMAWORLD :)

Enter this micro-universe that is being updated with its new "Season 2222" which is bringing with it many new features and more artists from all over the world

Come and meet Damerino, the new gallery manager who will accompany you and tell you about all the artists who are featured in this new exhibition.
Read the various stories linked to the artists to better understand how they ended up inside this gallery

Enjoy a unique museum experience in a hybrid combining videogames and art

Last but not least
Have fun :P
